adjudication.rationale: In `handleNewBooking.ts`, `evt.destinationCalendar` is initialized to `null` when neither `eventType.destinationCalendar` nor `organizerUser.destinationCalendar` exists (`destinationCalendar: ... : null,`). Immediately after, for COLLECTIVE team events it does `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`, which becomes a no-op when `evt.destinationCalendar` is `null`, so any collected `teamDestinationCalendars` are silently discarded. This is directly verifiable from the diff and breaks the intended behavior of adding team members’ destination calendars.
